study type: Retrospective analysis of nationally-representative cross-sectional survey data
exposure: receipt of Janani Suraksha Yojna (JSY) benefits
length of stay (when associated with postnatal care and complications)
cohort: Women who gave birth in India during a five-year period preceding the National Family Health Survey-4 (2015-16).
finding: The study found that early discharge is negatively associated with maternal health outcomes, leading to lower levels of postnatal care and a higher proportion of post-delivery complications.
mod_finding: The average length of stay is 2.1 days for vaginal deliveries and 8.6 days for cesarean section deliveries.
